lines.zh: 我后腿站直，竖着走两步。
lines.en: I stand on my hind legs and shuffle two steps.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚，快步穿过草地。
lines.en: On tiptoe, I trot across the grass.
I keep looking back as I go.

lines.zh: 我绕过蚁丘，走到那根枯枝旁。
lines.en: I skirt the anthill to the dead branch.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面嗅，鼻子不停。
lines.en: I sniff along the ground, nose busy.

lines.zh: 我从草丛一头钻到另一头。
lines.en: I scoot from one end of the grass to the other.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴翘着，像一根杆子。
lines.en: My tail sticks up like a little pole.

lines.zh: 我走几步就站起来看远处。
lines.en: Every few steps I stand up and scan.
I move along the stone cracks carefully.

lines.zh: 我踩在枯草上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My feet on dry grass barely make a sound.

lines.zh: 我让开了路上的响尾蛇印。
lines.en: I step around the snake trail in the sand.
Back arched, I move quickly.

lines.zh: 我站在一块石头上放哨。
lines.en: I stand watch on a flat stone.
My nose never stops twitching.
I hold my tail perfectly straight.
I look up for hawks.

lines.zh: 我把肚皮摊在晒热的土上
lines.en: I spread my belly on the sun-warmed soil.
I scratch my ear with a hind leg.
My burrow mouth is right beside me.
I stretch my neck to see the distance.
The sun has made the stone hot.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我在数草原上有几只同伴。
lines.en: I count how many kin are on the savanna.
The wind rolls the grass in waves.

lines.zh: 我蹲在洞口打了个长哈欠
lines.en: I sit by the burrow and yawn a long yawn.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞口坐着，能马上钻进去。
lines.en: I sit by my burrow, ready to dive in.
I smell ants.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在风里抖了一下。
lines.en: One ear twitches in the wind.
I stand up to check again.
Nothing's moving, so I'll wait a bit.
You look like a tower to me.
You carry an unfamiliar smell.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你，随时能跑。
lines.en: I'm watching you, ready to run.
Could you crouch down?

lines.zh: 我这边有个洞，你追不上。
lines.en: I have a hole here you can't follow me into.
Is that thing in your hand edible?
My kin is on watch over there.
Hold still and let me look first.

lines.zh: 你的影子把洞口盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my burrow.
I'm not used to talking with my head up.
Your footsteps are far too heavy.
Are you trying to catch me?
I'm one hop from my burrow.
I watch and get ready to run.
You're new to this savanna.
I don't know you yet; stand back.
I squeak and dive for the burrow.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴软软地拖在地上
lines.en: My tail hangs limp and drags on the ground.
I back up two steps, watching you.
A wound like this is serious for me.
I hug the ground and don't move.
My kin have started calling.
I turn two circles on the spot.

lines.zh: 我的后腿撑不住，直打颤
lines.en: My hind legs won't hold; they keep shaking.
I stop only at the burrow's edge.
I'm still up, but very tense.
Food? Put it on the ground.
Step back a little and I'll come.

lines.zh: 那股香味钻进我的鼻子
lines.en: That smell works its way into my nose.
I could eat that.
Keep still; I'm a little nervous.

lines.zh: 四周没动静我才敢过来
lines.en: Only if nothing stirs will I come over.
Will any of my kin come to grab it?

lines.zh: 我把鼻子往前探了一寸
lines.en: I push my nose forward by an inch.
I'll take one piece and go.
Don't laugh; I'm a little nervous.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住了我的尾尖
lines.en: Your heel pins the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我倒退着撞上你的靴子。
lines.en: I back into your boot.
I dive into the burrow.
You nearly flattened me.
I dart between your legs.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我翻了个身。
lines.en: We bump and I roll over.
I stand up and brush off the dirt.
You step back, and only then do I come out.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你鞋上刮了一下。
lines.en: My claws scrape your shoe.

lines.zh: 我被碰得一缩，竖起耳朵
lines.en: The knock makes me duck and prick my ears.
We take turns on watch.

lines.zh: 我靠在它肩上，暖和一点。
lines.en: I lean against it; it's warmer.
It stands a little taller than me.

lines.zh: 我们一起刨开一条新洞。
lines.en: We dig a new tunnel together.
It calls, and I call back.
We keep the young ones in the middle.
It watches the other side for me.
We sleep stacked together.

lines.zh: 它会分享一块虫肉给我。
lines.en: It shares a bit of insect meat with me.

lines.zh: 风一响，我们就同时站起来。
lines.en: When the wind stirs, we both stand up at once.
A bit of insect meat; I carry it in my teeth.
I carry it back to the burrow in both paws.
Is this edible? Let me sniff first.
I claw the sand aside and hide it in a crack.
Any food dropped on the ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，拖了两下没动
lines.en: I bite it and tug twice; it will not budge.
I eat it in one bite.
I hide it in the burrow and eat slowly.
This thing glints and I can't gnaw it.
I push it over to my kin.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我站起来了。
lines.en: Something's moving; I'm up on my hind legs.
First I see how big it is.
The burrow is right at my feet.
I don't fight; I fall back first.
I give one short cry.
They all heard it.
I rise on my hind legs, tail pulled taut.
That direction isn't safe.
I duck low and shift into the grass.
I withdraw half a step at a time.
I keep watching it from behind.
The moment it turns, I'm in the burrow.

lines.zh: 我叫了三声，同伴都躲了。
lines.en: Three cries, and my kin are all hidden.
It can't see me in the grass.

lines.zh: 我压低身子从草根旁绕
lines.en: I flatten low and slip round the grass roots.
My burrow has five ways out.
It takes a step; I give half.
My nose has memorized it.

lines.zh: 它在找什么，我不想知道。
lines.en: What it's looking for, I don't want to know.
I wait until it turns away.

lines.zh: 我叼住它的爪尖啃了一下
lines.en: I catch its claw tip and gnaw once.
One scratch from my claws.
I spring up and ram its ankle.

lines.zh: 我这一口连皮都没咬破
lines.en: My bite doesn't even break the skin.
I bite its toe and pull back at once.
I'm guarding my burrow.
My teeth are for insects.

lines.zh: 真打起来我撑不了两下
lines.en: In a real fight I last about two blows.
I shriek and fling myself at its foot.
I fall back at once.
I poke my head out of the burrow.

lines.zh: 我先看鹰，再闻脚下的土
lines.en: I check the sky for hawks, then sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 草原上多了一根竖着的尾巴。
lines.en: One more tail stands up on the savanna.
The burrows here are mine.
I come out of the burrow and shake off the sand.
A kin calls me from far off.
The sun has just reached my burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我站起来，把周围看了一圈。
lines.en: I stand and scan all around.
I've found a good spot.
I smell this grass for the first time.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，很难看见。
lines.en: My shadow is small and hard to spot.
I duck into the burrow and wait.
Fire comes, and I'm straight down the burrow.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下来，摔懵了。
lines.en: I fall off the stone and land dazed.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的洞口，我呛了两下。
lines.en: Water reaches my burrow mouth and I choke.

lines.zh: 土块炸起来，盖了我一身。
lines.en: Clods of earth burst up and cover me.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我旁边的土里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the dirt beside me.

lines.zh: 一道光罩住我，我动不了。
lines.en: A light closes over me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 找不到虫子，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No bugs to find, and I grow lighter.
The thunder folds me into a ball.
No ground; I can't find a burrow.
